title: SEC exec: VP part of food firm’s board while in office

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte stayed on the board and retained her stake in a food company for three years after becoming Vice President, with a Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) official saying on Monday that her continued corporate roles could violate the constitutional ban on government officials participating in business. Lawyer Gerardo del Rosario, director of the SEC’s Company Registration and Monitoring Department, testified that Duterte retained a 20-percent stake in Metro City Chow Foods Corp. from 2016 to 2025 and remained on its board from 2018 to 2025.He also confirmed that Duterte was listed as a member […]...
